messages:
alice_oncall: incident-bot paged on high error rate for auth introspect in us-west-2. investigating.
incident-bot: [ALERT] auth-introspect errors > 20% (5m) — service: auth-gateway — region: us-west-2 — alert: INT-502-INTROSPECT
alice_oncall: assigning to SRE + infra. bumping priority.
ben_sre: digging into logs now. seeing upstream 502/504 spikes to auth0-introspect starting ~2026-03-15T17:42:00Z. small QPS but high failure percentage.
ben_sre: log paste:
```
[2026-03-15T17:42:13Z] upstream auth0-introspect 502 recv: \"502 Bad Gateway\"
[2026-03-15T17:42:15Z] auth-check user=acct-123 token=xxxx status=502 latency=120ms
```
emma_eng: traces show TLS connection resets to a subset of Auth0 edge nodes; retries are making things worse (retry storm).
frank_cs: customer reports: console login failures for some orgs, elevated mobile auth errors — ~100 tickets in 30m, a few enterprise customers impacted.
dave_support: standing up high-touch for affected accounts, drafting public status.
ben_sre: proposing quick mitigations: 1) circuit-breaker on introspect calls (fail fast after 2 attempts), 2) enable local token-cache fallback for console sessions, 3) route us-west-2 traffic to Auth0 alternate edge when possible.
alice_oncall: rolling circuit-breaker change now. exec:
`kubectl -n prod exec deploy/auth-gateway -- curl -X POST localhost:8080/config?circuit=enable`
alice_oncall: circuit tripped on failures, observed drop in error rate to ~7% within 5m.
ben_sre: enabling cache-fallback canary (5%) to reduce user-visible login failures:
`/admin/feature_flags set auth.introspect_cache_fallback true --canary=0.05`
emma_eng: applying a temporary policy: treat 502 as transient and consult local cache for tokens issued <1h, per runbook: https://runbook.internal/runbooks/auth0-introspect-fallback
olivia_ops_bot: Incident created: INCD-20260315-127 — PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.internal/INC12345 — Severity: P2
frank_cs: status page draft:
"We are investigating authentication failures affecting console logins and some token verifications. Engineers are working with our auth provider. Some customers may experience login errors; updates every 30 minutes."
ben_sre: opened Auth0 support ticket, seeing intermittent TLS handshake failures to edge nodes. Auth0 case ID: AUTH0-78921. pinged for escalation.
emma_eng: pattern: A/B edge pool in us-west-2 returning 502/TLS resets; looks like regional backend ingress issue.
alice_oncall: quick impact estimate: ~18% of logins in us-west-2 failing; global fallback routing reduced overall impact to ~6%.
dave_support: posting initial status update to status.redwood.com and notifying customers. next update in 30m.
ben_sre: combined mitigations (circuit-breaker + cache-fallback + route override) brought errors down to ~2-4% but still occasional bursts during retry windows.
emma_eng: recommended next steps: keep cache-fallback for 2 hours, hard-route introspect to Auth0 alternate edge for region, request Auth0 backend health details and ETA.
alice_oncall: applying route override flag for us-west-2:
`/admin/routing set auth0.endpoint us-west-2:edge-alt --selector=region:us-west-2`
alice_oncall: monitoring after change.
olivia_ops_bot: Note: schedule handoff in 50 minutes to night-oncall (henry_oncall).
henry_oncall: ack — will take night watch and keep mitigations active. leave handoff summary here before stepping down.
ben_sre: Auth0 replied: "We are investigating a regional ingress issue impacting TLS sessions to us-west-2 edge; mitigation in progress, no ETA." — case AUTH0-78921.
alice_oncall: current snapshot: error rate ~1.8%, console login failures mostly resolved via cache-fallback. plan to gradually restore normal routing in 30m if stable.
emma_eng: enable verbose logging for next 2 hours; set regression alert: if rate >3% for 15m, re-escalate.
frank_cs: posted updated customer notice; CSMs looped for affected enterprise tenants.
dave_support: sent list of impacted enterprise tenants to CSMs and offered manual session restores where needed.
henry_oncall: handoff notes for night: mitigations active (circuit-breaker, cache-fallback, route override), Auth0 ticket AUTH0-78921, monitor 5m rollups, escalate if >3% for 15m, runbook link https://runbook.internal/runbooks/auth0-introspect-fallback.
alice_oncall: standing down — thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] auth-introspect errors returned to baseline (<2%) — incident marked mitigated. Incident INCD-20260315-127 -> postmortem required.
ben_sre: created postmortem stub: https://docs.internal/incidents/INCD-20260315-127 — collecting timelines and RCA. Recommended follow-ups: add fallback routing section to runbook, request Auth0 RCA, evaluate retry behavior to avoid amplification.
emma_eng: will own runbook updates and follow-up items.
frank_cs: preparing customer-facing post-incident summary for impacted accounts.
henry_oncall: will coordinate postmortem meeting and overnight watch.
alice_oncall: closing thread.
